column1: # No OTA (D7): a single `factory` app slot

# IDF 4.4 partition generator and PlatformIO's `uploadfs` both recognise it.
# PROVISIONAL until M6. Repartitioning wipes LittleFS
# numbers must happen before the radio is reassembled. The M3 logo-set
# measurement is what confirms 1.87 MB of filesystem is the right call.
